copy.caption: Full day-by-day itinerary in the first comment. Eighteen days from Auckland along the Silk Road, from Xi'an through Jiayuguan, Dunhuang and Turpan to Urumqi. International and domestic flights, 4-5 star hotels, an English-speaking tour guide and the 38 meals listed in the itinerary are in the price. NZD $7,999 per person, twin share; single supplement NZD $1,488. Travel insurance, visa fee if required, and tips are not included.
